rows.description: Plan says pipeline_list for a project with no pipelines gets a pointer to pipeline_docs (topic pipeline-design). Only the pipeline_start message was changed; list() still returns the bare empty list.
Plan says the index names the contract version, but CONTRACT_VERSION is not in the answer; only engine_version and pipeline_file_version {baseline, max_major} are.

Two items of the plan's test list have no test: the over-MCP check in the CLI tests (tools/list includes pipeline_docs, calling it returns the index) and the idempotent hint on pipeline_docs (only readOnly is pinned, via the tool-list snapshot).

The sentinels '# Checks' and '# Examples' are substrings that could match unrelated bundled text, so the check can pass even if the markdown was dropped. A unique sentinel line per topic would be stronger.
The plan lists an example with a nothing_to_change outcome; the outcomes field is shown in no example, only in the pipeline-spec prose.
The strict example says 'standard with a review after the tests' but merges verify and test into one verify node. The plan's lean profile includes plan; the docs' lean has none.

The generated 'Every node' table omits checks (the parser adds it per kind), and the check tables omit the universal kind and on_fail; only the checks prose mentions on_fail. The reference never states that a node has a checks list; an agent learns it only from the examples.

The Edges table is hand-written, not generated, although the plan says the reference is read from the schemas; edgeSchema is not exported (the plan says to export it), so the table can drift, and the undescribed-fields test does not cover the edge fields.

The trap 'A result check needs an edge for its on_fail label' overstates the rule: the parser requires failure-label edges only for command and human nodes (requiresRoutes). A failing agent node without an edge is retried, as pipeline-spec.md:15 says, so the two statements disagree.
version is described as 'absent means 1', but the project config's version is used first (resolveVersion with configVersion).

Parser rules that expected_duration must not exceed timeout and max_consecutive_failures must not exceed max_attempts are not documented, nor is the \{{ escape; an agent can fail validation without having been told.
The edit strips KODEL_ENGINE from the spawned process environment. It is unrelated to the plan (scope addition), harmless; it fixes a test that failed inside the engine.

Checked against the code and accurate: on_fail defaults to failed, human nodes take no checks, {{task}} is rejected in any command field, diff modes and the since default node, fail_when limited to enum or boolean columns. All yaml examples parse.
